$comment: Heimdall demo dataset - Nordvik E-Drive Plant NV1 (FICTIONAL). Reference / master data only: organization, users, machine hierarchy, controllers, installed parts, component slots and the spare-part store. Activity (telemetry, tickets, part consumption) is produced by the fleet simulator. Columns are named exactly like the live PostgreSQL columns. '_key' values become deterministic demo UUIDs (prefix de30de30-), '@key' strings are references to them, '~now-3h' strings are timestamps relative to load time. metadata.partClass (serialized parts) and metadata.consumableClass (stock items) tell the simulator which spare fits which installed component. Loaded by scripts/seed_demo_data.py.
